hints.title: Character Classification
hints.text: Distinguish vowels from consonants and maintain separate occurrence counts for each category.

hints.title: Frequency Accumulation
hints.text: Accumulate occurrences across the string into two distinct frequency maps.

hints.title: Maximum Selection
hints.text: Find the maximum frequency among vowels and consonants independently, returning their sum.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Alphabet size is bounded by 26 characters.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Repeated string scans take quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Fixed size arrays provide optimal lookup and accumulation speed.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Handle edge cases with missing vowels or missing consonants cleanly.
